atoms.name: Handshake, flags and teardown
atoms.one_line: SYN, SYN+ACK, ACK; FIN-WAIT-1/2, TIME-WAIT; either end may close; RST aborts.

atoms.name: Sequence and ack numbers
atoms.one_line: Numbers count bytes; ack is the next byte expected; SYN and FIN each consume one number, a bare ACK none.

atoms.name: Flow control and window
atoms.one_line: Receiver window rwnd (16 bits, up to 65535 bytes, scale shift at most 14); sender window is min(cwnd, rwnd).

atoms.name: Slow start and congestion avoidance
atoms.one_line: cwnd doubles per RTT up to ssthresh, then adds one MSS per RTT; write cwnd as a row of rounds.

atoms.name: Reaction to loss
atoms.one_line: Timeout: ssthresh = cwnd/2, cwnd = 1. Triple duplicate ACK (Reno): ssthresh = cwnd/2, cwnd = ssthresh.

atoms.name: RTT estimate and timeout
atoms.one_line: EstimatedRTT = (1-alpha) Est + alpha Sample, alpha = 1/8; RTO = Est + 4 Dev.

atoms.name: Sequence space and wrap-around
atoms.one_line: Space is 2^n bytes; wrap time = 2^n x 8 / bandwidth; bits needed >= log2(bytes per MSL).

atoms.name: Socket API
atoms.one_line: Server: socket, bind, listen, accept. Client: socket, connect (sends SYN). UDP connect only sets a peer.

atoms.name: Throughput and pipe
atoms.one_line: Throughput = window / RTT; a full pipe needs window >= bandwidth x RTT.
